purpose: Generic honest-fallback checks proving Headroom is never falsely reported active and tree-sitter fallback is correctly labeled.

generic_checks.shape: headroom probe with health endpoint failing
probe with health ok but compressed!=true
probe with health ok + compressed=true but tokens_saved<=0

generic_checks.assertion: fallback_used=true recorded; not counted as Headroom active

generic_checks.shape: context pack emitted on an unseen repo subset
static check of F8 diff for any Cursor/process kill

generation_rule: probe outcomes are varied across the three proof dimensions independently; the invariant is honest BLOCKED_ENV reporting whenever any proof is absent
